seth_override.scope: this client only, billed on Upwork

fill.[ENGAGEMENT NAME]: Receipts, Invoices And Monthly Reconciliation in QuickBooks
fill.[COVER SUBTITLE]: Card receipts and the nightly vendor invoices land in QuickBooks already coded, and each month you see only what does not match.
fill.[SITUATION TITLE]: The Bookkeeping Still Runs By Hand
fill.[SITUATION LEAD]: Arborgold already sends your invoices and payments into QuickBooks Desktop. Bills, card charges and reconciling are still done by hand in the office.
fill.[SITUATION DETAIL]: You buy a lot online on the Chase card and forward each receipt to the office with a note for the account and memo. One main vendor emails a PDF invoice each night there are purchases. Each month the card is reconciled and anything not already in QuickBooks is highlighted for your review.
fill.[STAGE 2 NOTE]: With a note for the office
fill.[COST LINE 1]: Every receipt and every nightly vendor invoice is typed into QuickBooks by hand.
fill.[COST LINE 2]: A charge that should not have been made is only caught when the card is reconciled.
fill.[AFTER TITLE]: Bills and charges arrive coded, and month end shows only what needs you
fill.[AFTER BODY]: Card receipts and the nightly vendor invoices land in QuickBooks with the account and memo filled in, and anything unsure waits for your review. Each month the bank accounts and the Chase card are matched, and you see only what does not match.
fill.[SCOPE INTRO]: Two pieces, in order. Receipts and invoices come first, then the monthly reconciliation works from the same QuickBooks records.
fill.[WEEK 1 SUMMARY]: Receipt and invoice intake set up on the office inbox.
fill.[WEEK 2 SUMMARY]: Coding rules built and tested on your past bills and charges.
fill.[WEEK 3 SUMMARY]: Bills and charges posting into QuickBooks, with unsure items held for you.
fill.[WEEK 4 SUMMARY]: Monthly reconciliation live, walkthrough recorded, support window opens.
